name: Windows Shortcuts
description: Windows 11 keyboard shortcuts, grouped and easy to search.

shortcuts.start_menu: Open or close the Start menu
shortcuts.notification_center: Open the notification center and calendar
shortcuts.security_screen: Open the security screen (lock, switch user, sign out…)
shortcuts.snap_left: Snap the window to the left side of the screen
shortcuts.snap_right: Snap the window to the right side of the screen
shortcuts.snap_top_half: Snap the window to the top half of the screen
shortcuts.snap_bottom_half: Snap the window to the bottom half of the screen
shortcuts.restore_window: Restore a snapped or maximized window
shortcuts.stretch_vertical: Stretch the window to the top and bottom of the screen
shortcuts.move_monitor_left: Move the window to the monitor on the left
shortcuts.move_monitor_right: Move the window to the monitor on the right
shortcuts.next_desktop: Switch to the desktop on the right
shortcuts.previous_desktop: Switch to the desktop on the left
shortcuts.explorer_close_tab: Close the active tab (or the window if only one tab is open)
shortcuts.explorer_properties: Show properties for the selected item
shortcuts.explorer_context_menu: Show the context menu for the selected item
shortcuts.explorer_delete_permanently: Delete permanently, without moving to the Recycle Bin
shortcuts.explorer_up: Move up a level in the folder path
shortcuts.explorer_preview_pane: Show or hide the preview pane
shortcuts.explorer_details_pane: Show or hide the details pane
shortcuts.screenshot_region: Select a region of the screen to capture to the clipboard
shortcuts.screenshot_full_to_file: Capture the full screen and save it to Pictures\Screenshots
shortcuts.screenshot_to_clipboard: Capture a region of the screen (default Print Screen behavior)
shortcuts.screenshot_active_window: Capture the active window to the clipboard
shortcuts.record_screen: Select a region of the screen to record as a video
shortcuts.color_filters: Turn color filters on or off (if enabled in settings)
shortcuts.high_contrast: Turn High Contrast on or off (left Alt + left Shift + Print Screen)
shortcuts.voice_typing_focus: Move keyboard focus to the voice typing dialog
shortcuts.next_input_language: Switch forward through input languages and keyboard layouts
shortcuts.previous_input_language: Switch backward through input languages and keyboard layouts
shortcuts.paste_plain_text: Paste as plain text (depends on the app)
shortcuts.delete_word_left: Delete the word to the left of the cursor
